annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 897/2024 - Dispõe sobre a Autenticação de Mídia Digital criada ou modificada por Inteligência Artificial (IA) e dá outras providências
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 897/2024 - On the Authentication of Digital Media Created or Modified by Artificial Intelligence (AI)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dep. Saullo Vianna (União/AM), Câmara dos Deputados
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Chamber of Deputies bill (March 2024) requiring clear, visible, automated labelling and authentication of all digital media generated or modified by AI, with platforms responsible for verification mechanisms and unspecified authorities empowered to inspect and sanction. It addresses deepfakes and misinformation; no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Mandatory authentication of all AI-generated or AI-modified digital media
Clear, visible marking of origin and authenticity
Marking and authentication done automatically via verification algorithms
Digital platforms responsible for mechanisms ensuring authenticity
Competent bodies may inspect and apply sanctions
